source: USGS NHDPlus HR NetworkNHDFlowline committed graph topology

rules.direction: downstream graph edge orientation; upstream/downstream boundary stops are explicit per record
rules.bridges: flagged straight connectors between remaining open ends, counted in properties.bridgedSegments and trace.bridgedSegments
rules.noShrinkGuard: rebuild declined when walked length < 0.9 x committed lengthKm
